data.description: An array with x and y values.

dataIndex.description: The index in the series of the point clicked.

name.description: The point label (what appears on the x axis).

seriesIndex.description: The index of the series that was clicked (among all series on the chart).

eventType.description: The type of event, e.g. "click", "hover" etc.

value.description: An array of x and y values.
